# DiffusionModelTopology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The mapping of diffusion model's forward/reverse stochastic processes onto topological structures (e.g., manifolds, graphs) that encode data geometry. Links the geometric structure of data to the topological properties of computing substrates, enabling topology-aware neuromorphic implementations.
